race.description: Barmah Park Restaurant & Cellar Door Mdn Plate
race.comment: OCEANS BLUE (9) brings the strongest race form after placing at both starts, and her first-up second at Kyneton reads well given she was beaten a length after racing wide without cover as a short odds-on favourite. Fitter now and profiles very well for this. FLARE OF GRACE (5) is the key unknown, but a Pakenham trial win for the Ben, Will & JD Hayes stable gives her hope on debut having jumped out well. Respecting first time out. CIRQUE DE COCO (4) has race experience on her side, was beaten only a neck at Geelong two runs back, and has trialled twice for her return. Look for a betting push. SAVANINA (12) is bred to have ability as a full sister to G1 winner Pasadena Girl and has Jamie Melham booked. Watch the betting.
